warnings: *** EXTRACTION METHOD FOR THIS SHEET -- READ THIS BEFORE TRUSTING IT. *** The two BOQ sets in this book (ฐานรากแผ่ at PNG 71-87 and ฐานรากเข็มตอก at PNG 88-104) are the SAME 34-sheet ปร.4 template issued twice, differing only in (a) the foundation name in the title line and (b) the foundation item inside หมวดงานโครงสร้าง. The page mapping is exact and one-to-one: set-2 PNG = set-1 PNG + 17, same physical half, same แผ่นที่ n/34. That mapping and the line-for-line identity of the non-structural categories were VERIFIED VISUALLY at ten points spanning the whole range: 88_1 (1/34), 88_2 (2/34), 89_1 (3/34), 89_2 (4/34), 90_1 (5/34), 90_2 (6/34), 91_1 (7/34), 95_2 (16/34), 99_1 (23/34), 104_2 (34/34). This particular sheet's rows were NOT re-read from its own PNG; they were carried across from the verified-identical ฐานรากแผ่ counterpart named in derived_from. Anyone using this file for anything quantity-critical should re-read its own PNG first.

PNG contains TWO portrait BOQ sheets laid out side by side in one landscape scan, per spec §11. Rotate the PNG 90 degrees counter-clockwise to read. The physical RIGHT half is the LOWER-numbered sheet and is written to _1.json; the physical LEFT half is _2.json.

EVERY PRICE COLUMN IS BLANK ON EVERY ROW OF THE WHOLE BOQ -- ราคาหน่วยละ, จำนวนเงิน (material and labour), and รวมค่าวัสดุและค่าแรงงาน. This is a แบบ ปร.4 QUANTITY schedule issued unpriced by กองมาตรฐานราคากลาง for the estimator to fill in. Nulls are transcribed, never invented.

The title block is identical on every sheet of the set: form แบบ ปร.4, drawing numbers S-62047 / AR-61142 / SN-62034 / EE-62062 / M-62028, สถานที่ก่อสร้าง ทั่วไป, unit บาท, with ประมาณการโดย and ประมาณราคาเมื่อวันที่ left blank.
Rainwater pipework, ø3" -- matching the ø3"RL and ø3"RD+RL tags on SN-04 and SN-05.

*** ONLY 4 METRES OF RAINWATER PIPE AND ONE ROOF DRAIN, WHICH IS STRIKINGLY LITTLE FOR A HOUSE WITH 207 ตร.ม. OF TILED ROOF PLUS 26 ตร.ม. OF METAL SHEET. *** The reason is that the pitched roofs discharge to eaves and to the RC surface channel (SN-10, priced under 3.6) rather than to internal downpipes; the single RD is the balcony drain shown at the same corner on both SN-04 and SN-05, and the 4 m is the one downpipe between them.
The RD count of 1 matches SN-05 exactly -- one ø3"RD+RL at the balcony corner and nothing else.

SN-08 details BOTH a domed roof drain (RD) and a flat one (RFD). Only RD is priced, so the RFD detail is unused -- consistent with the SN-08 warning that several details on that sheet are standard office details for fixtures this house does not have.
Same six-line pattern as the soil and waste sheets, minus the FD/P-TRAP/FCO lines which do not apply to rainwater.
